name: GetEmailsByFolderName
description: Retrieves email messages from a specified folder in a mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox to retrieve emails from.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The display name of the folder to retrieve emails from. The folder must already exist in the mailbox.

fields.name: Top
fields.label: Top
fields.description: Number of emails to retrieve for pagination.

fields.name: Skip
fields.label: Skip
fields.description: Number of emails to skip for pagination.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the email retrieval operation, including the list of emails in the specified folder and any error messages.
